dialogue.line: We have to get inside! We'll be safe in there.
Why were you screaming like that?
I had a really bad dream.
This bitch blew out our ride home with a fucking shotgun!
You have no idea what you're doing.
This whole time you've been less than
two hours away with these people.
You'll feel better if you come outside.
I can't fucking do this anymore.
You shouldn't be doing this. Victor wouldn't like it.
Every time I see something really weird, I see this.
Come on, Victor. Go, Victor, go!
Maybe this is just gonna be like one of those crazy stories
that we just tell at parties, and it'll be fun and--
Please help us. We were on a bus.
You ever wonder if Abby was right?
What if it's all just a dream?
My blood is your blood now.
What do you mean it collapsed? Which house collapsed?
The one next to the diner.

I-- Then I was someplace else.

No, I... Maybe. I don't know.
When you say it like that, it sounds frickin' crazy.
She said she was gonna be right behind me.
So, do you think she's alive?
Okay, look, I need you to really just take me through this, okay?
Look, you went through a tree and then what?
I got lucky. I found my way. I-I--
No, look, look, if you don't wanna tell me,
just say that you don't wanna tell me.
You said that you were gonna find answers.
You said you were gonna go out there
and find answers or find a way home!
And now we're exactly where we fucking started!
Look, last night it got bad.
Yeah, I, I feel like the people that make it here,
There's a part of themselves that they hold on to.
And... I just think, you know...
Look, last night I feel like I saw
that piece of her... start to slip away.
Then it has to be you, okay?
You have to be that piece of her that this place can't take away.
That's how we get through this. Okay?
Even if we lose our way,
we hold on to each other and we keep trying.
I'm gonna go give Kenny a hand
checking on the animal traps and--
You know, I figured while I was out there I could, uh,
pick her some of those wildflowers she likes.
Hey, you know what? You should, uh,
think about getting her a new ring.
All done. Good. You did great.
I'm just gonna clip it here, okay?
Alright. Just try to keep it dry, okay?
We can take them out in probably a week or two, alright?
...three cracked ribs and probably a bruised lung.
I wouldn't exactly call that fine, okay?
Just catching my breath, that's all.
I... heard you had a pretty rough night too.
She was on a quest with Victor.
Um, look, bottom line is, you got really lucky.
So just don't do anything to make it worse, okay?
I'll check back on you in a bit.
Kids, can you give me and your mom a second?
Donna said we could stay at the Colony House,
but there's no way in hell I'm taking the kids--
the wires aren't connected to anything.
Yeah, they were just dangling from the ceiling.
Tabitha, we have so much to talk about.
How are the kids holding up?
I think I'm gonna take them to the diner
to see if I can get some food. I don't know when they've eaten.
You are not listening to me.
No, I'm listening, and I'm telling you to fuck off.
You think after what happened last night
I'm just gonna trust you people?
That is not gonna do any good against
those things that come out at night!
All you're gonna do is make everyone here nervous.
No, but it's okay for you to start shooting out fuckin' tires
though, right? Because that made people real fuckin' calm!
Whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa, hey, hey, Donna.
What's-- What's goin' on here? What's goin' on, Donna?
I thought the Asian guy was the sheriff.
We're just having a little disagreement about firearms.
I understand this is all pretty scary, right?
But I've had a strange fuckin' week,
so I'm a little less patient than normal.
You don't like the rules. Great.
You take your rifle, you go live out in the woods,
and make whatever rules you like.
You want a roof over your head at night when those things
come out to hunt, then you put the fucking rifle down
and you listen to the lady.
the time to talk, okay? Answer all your questions.
...that we are all in this thing together,
and the only way to get through this is together.
Honey, you need to eat something.
He's been through a rough few days.
I hope he's not mad at me.
Why would he be mad at you?
Me and Jade were in his room.
He said he was looking for clues about how to get home.
I told him Victor wouldn't like it.

Can I-- Can I talk to you for a second?

and I was wondering if maybe I could go through the storage?
Everything we had was in that house.

Storm wiped out half our crop.

she's pinned to the tree, so I...

this could be the key to getting the hell out of here.

I held it when I slept.
I, um... I like the blonde.

and that's the rock I painted for you sitting there

Uh, it was just called that when I got here.

I mean, she's literally sitting there and talking.

Uh, I mean, it could be hours. It could be days.
I-- She's not suffering right now,
but I don't know how long that's gonna last.
Those things, they'll be back tonight.
Okay, so then we have to get her out of here.
Look, I don't think you understand.

So then, what do we do?

No, nothing that would be strong enough.
We have to pull out the rod.

Mom, this has a huge hole in it.
So? If it fits, it goes.
Oh, just like this one. Perfect.

You know, once your dad's back on his feet,
I don't know. Nothing. Let's go home.

for months I could still hear him crying.
